title: MemoryRecord
description: A single memory record in the MemorySmith system

Id.description: Stable safe identifier used as the file name

Status.description: Lifecycle state. Current file-backed records use numeric .NET enum values: 0 Unconsolidated, 1 Working, 2 Core, 3 Deprecated.

References.description: IDs of other memories this one references

Conflicts.description: IDs of memories that conflict with this one

Label.description: Display label for the source link

Uri.description: URI or file path; %VarName% tokens are expanded at display time using Data/vars.json

StartLine.description: Optional 1-based start line for file references

EndLine.description: Optional 1-based end line (inclusive) for file references

SourceLinks.description: Source file or URL references. Supports %VarName% path variable expansion.
